The State of Jharkhand ... ...

Opposite Party
 Coram :- Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ratnaker Bhengra
 For the Petitioner :- Mr. Ritesh Kumar, Advocate
 For the State :- Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto, App
 ...
Heard both the counsels.
The petitioner is an accused in this case for the offence registered under sections 366-A and 376 of the IPC and sections 8 and 12 of the POCSO Act.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the allegation in the FIR, as per the written report, has been instituted at the instance of mother of the victim.
Initially, the section involved was section 366-A of the IPC.
Subsequently, section 376 of the IPC has been added.

The learned counsel has further submitted that there was friendly relationship between both the persons, who are young persons and from the statement made under section 164 CrPC, it is clear that victim had gone willingly and thereafter stayed with the petitioner at Ranchi.
There is no allegation of sexual assault in her statement.

Moreover, in the school certificate, the age of the victim on the date of offence was 15 years and 3 months and the medical board has assessed the age of the victim in between 16-17 years, therefore, benefit may be given to the petitioner.
Moreover, the petitioner is in custody since 15.04.2022.
Therefore, the petitioner may be granted privilege of bail.

Learned counsel for the State, has vehemently opposed the bail application of the petitioner and has submitted that serious allegations have been made and she was taken away by the petitioner and therefore, the allegations are made under sections 366-A and 376 of the IPC and sections 8 and 12 of the POCSO Act.

Having gone through the records of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for both the sides, present petitioner, named above, is ordered to be released on bail on executing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, POCSO Act,
